findings.text: the wait-status fields spread into every launch_failures entry are recorded by the code and named as an artifact in the manifest, but no test asserts them (the empty-stream case at tests/test_crew_launch_failure.py:286 checks exit_status, argv, backend and stderr_tail only), so a regression deleting that spread leaves the suite green on that surface while the two run-record cases stay covered.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 91e4095a; ff1c26cf adds the helper and keeps the status for unplaced reaps, b0c8ff90 narrows nothing the goal asks for and restores the pre-existing invariant that a placed run whose payload log shows a turn ran gains no record, which tests/test_crew_placed_liveness.py:226 (assert recorded == []) caught red against the wider first cut, and 4bafc250 adds the section 5.1 landed summary, the evidence page's s5-1 section and the reap-branch figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure asks for both cases read from the run record with the stream non-empty, the declared negative control applied and observed red, and the focused tests green, and each holds: tests/test_crew_launch_failure.py:259-:261 assert signal 15, the name SIGTERM and a null exit code on a stub that writes a turn then kills itself, :279-:281 assert exit code 3 with no signal on a stub that exits, :264 and :282 show both streams non-empty so the record can only have come from the wait, negative-control-discard-wait-status.log:1 repeats the declared mutation verbatim with :8 recording the SIGTERM case red (1 failed, EXIT=1), and gate-wait-status-focused.log:3-4 records 7 passed EXIT=0 which I reproduced at the delivered head (logs/review-gate-rerun.log, 7 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the launcher record each worker's exit code, and where the process was signalled the signal number and name, on the run record, and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4105 derives both cases from the single wait status the reaper already held (a negative value is a signal, a non-negative one an exit code) and dispatch.py:4229 writes the result on the pointer's wait_status, so a worker ended by SIGTERM now carries signal 15 and SIGTERM where it carried nothing; the one deliberate exclusion is a placed launch at dispatch.py:4206, whose wait status belongs to the scheduler client, and the worker declares that boundary in the manifest's follow_ons rather than hiding it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full, status complete, commits ff1c26cf/b0c8ff90/4bafc250, both gate logs and the negative-control log resolve and say what the manifest says they say, and its claim that no plan-meta lines were edited holds exactly as stated.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff --numstat 91e4095a 4bafc250 lands exactly the five declared paths (reckon/crew/dispatch.py +66/-19, tests/test_crew_launch_failure.py +107, docs/evidence/archive/worker-death-is-recorded-landed.html +98, docs/plans/worker-death-is-recorded.html +6, docs/figures/worker-death-is-recorded +2466 across its three artifacts) and all 19 deletions sit inside the one function the goal rewrites, the old docstring and the five-line discard branch.

justifications.durability: the SIGTERM case is proven falsifiable by negative-control-discard-wait-status.log:8 going red on the reinstated discard and the exit case reddens if the else branch at dispatch.py:4126 is dropped, but the same three fields spread into each launch_failures entry at dispatch.py:4163 are asserted nowhere, so a regression removing that spread leaves the suite green (see FINDING).
justifications.evidence: gate-wait-status-focused.log:3-4 records the named file's 7 passed EXIT=0, negative-control-discard-wait-status.log:1 repeats the declared mutation verbatim with :8 showing the SIGTERM case red (1 failed, EXIT=1), and my own re-run of that file at 4bafc250 reproduced 7 passed EXIT=0 (logs/review-gate-rerun.log), the only imprecision being the gate log's header naming the tree as the unexpanded literal $PWD.
justifications.fit: the helper, its docstring voice and the two-case treatment follow the module's idiom, the source and test diff carry no plan, stage or ticket label, and ruff --no-cache over the two changed paths reports 7 findings at base 91e4095a against 7 at head, so the commit adds none.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both cases are asserted against the real process table and read back from the pointer at tests/test_crew_launch_failure.py:259 and :279, the only unrecorded case being a placed launch's wait at dispatch.py:4206, which the goal's "each worker" would cover but the placed-run invariant requires to be left alone and which the worker declared rather than hid.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --numstat 91e4095a 4bafc250 is one of the five the node declared and every deletion in dispatch.py is a line of the function the goal rewrites.
